bio.title: About Me – CV: Professional Background, Skills & Career
prose: Self-taught since 16, first in design, then in web development, with a 3-year print and digital apprenticeship in between for the qualification and the fundamentals. Eight years running my own studio on that combination of design and code, delivering global projects as a broad generalist. Photography has been a long-standing interest that keeps informing my visual work.

Taught myself design at 16 through self-initiated projects and formalised it in a 3-year print and digital apprenticeship, picking up web development on my own alongside it. Then I founded my own studio on that combination of design and code.

Over eight years I've delivered global projects balancing design and engineering, operating as a broad generalist under tight deadlines and with multiple stakeholders, handling communication across internal teams, freelancers, clients and executives. I've hired employees and contractors and set up internal and external processes across the board. Photography has been a long-standing interest that keeps informing my visual work.

Everything started on my own: design at 16, in self-initiated projects, long before anyone taught me a rule for it. The 3-year print and digital apprenticeship at b3plus came in between, for the formal qualification and to put what I already did on proper foundations. Web development I taught myself alongside it. In 2018 I founded my own studio on that combination of design and code.

Over eight years I've delivered global projects across industries, balancing design and engineering as a broad generalist under tight deadlines and with multiple stakeholders. I run the communication between internal teams, freelancers, clients and executives, have hired employees and contractors, and set up the internal and external processes the studio runs on, from the first proposal to deployment and the work after launch. Photography has been a long-standing interest that keeps informing my visual work.

timeline.title: unlimited.studio GmbH
list: Lead end-to-end web and product projects: strategy, UX/UI, full-stack development, deployment, and operations.
Manage cross-functional roadmaps and teams; own budgeting, resourcing, and studio operations for on-time, in-scope delivery to global clients.
Drive product strategy and research, including discovery, user research, and requirements, translating outcomes into design systems, prototypes, and scalable web apps/sites.
Build and ship solutions: architecture, production code, server/cloud setup, CI/CD, monitoring, and post-launch iteration.

Design and build unlimited.dock, the studio's own operations platform: Linear-style tasks, time tracking, team availability, quotes, budgets and an automated quote-to-project flow. It replaced our Productive.io subscription outright and carries around 8,000 tasks and 20,000 tracked hours.

Build and operate an in-house multi-tenant platform for client sites: lead pipeline and quoting, Stripe checkout, one-command deployment of a new site, a client portal with a block-based CMS and change-request workflow.
Ship native mobile: an iOS app for our own SaaS product built on Capacitor with custom native plugins.
Run client relations and communication, aligning stakeholders from proposal to delivery; facilitate workshops, maintain documentation, and nurture long-term partnerships.

Own growth: performance marketing (Google Ads, Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, Pinterest Ads, Meta Ads), tracking and attribution, funnels, reporting; social and lifecycle marketing (channels, content, community, newsletters/CRM, A/B tests, KPIs).

items.title: Code as a design tool.
items.content: I treat development as part of the design loop, iterating on ideas in code to achieve speed, precision, and higher interaction quality.

items.title: End-to-End execution.
items.content: Running a studio for eight years taught me to see the big picture—from strategy and design to full-stack development and operations.

items.title: Craft and detail.
items.content: I build interfaces that feel alive—using scroll-driven narratives and subtle motion to create web experiences where quality matters.

items.title: Holistic perspective.
items.content: I approach projects with a broad view, ensuring that brand identity, product design, and technical implementation evolve in unison.

items.title: Design Engineer.
items.content: I bridge the gap between disciplines, designing with technical feasibility in mind and developing with a designer’s eye for typography.

items.title: Flexible stack.
items.content: Experienced in Vue and Laravel but framework-agnostic. I learn fast and pick the right tool for the job.
